scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:preview
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npm run save
scripts.save: git add . && git commit -m "update" && git push
scripts.update: npm install taggedjs && npm run update:copies
scripts.update:copies: npm run copy:taggedjs:src && npm run copy:taggedjs:root
scripts.copy:taggedjs:src: mkdir -p src/taggedjs && cp node_modules/taggedjs/bundle.js src/taggedjs/bundle.js && cp node_modules/taggedjs/bundle.js.map src/taggedjs/bundle.js.map
scripts.copy:taggedjs:root: mkdir -p taggedjs && cp node_modules/taggedjs/bundle.js ./taggedjs/bundle.js && cp node_modules/taggedjs/bundle.js.map ./taggedjs/bundle.js.map
